headline: Gladstone Commercial Corporation Executes Lease Expansion at its Salt Lake City Property
summary:
MCLEAN, Va., May  28, 2019  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Gladstone Commercial Corporation (NASDAQ: GOOD) (“Gladstone Commercial”) announced today that it has expanded its tenant, Morgan Stanley, in its 104,903 square foot facility in South Jordan, Utah by 17,126 square feet, effective July 1, 2019. After the expansion, Morgan Stanley will occupy a total of 98,397 square feet at the property through December 31, 2027. The lease expansion increases the overall building occupancy to 93.8%.
